name: xianyu-listing-kit
description: Offline CLI for 闲鱼 (Xianyu) service listings: Chinese copy variants, SVG cover, price table, and banned-word lint.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --input-type=module -e "import { chmodSync } from 'node:fs'; chmodSync('dist/bin.js', 0o755)"
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/run-tests.mjs
